user.title: Add a fingerprint reader
user.description: Enter the ESPHome event prefix, without _finger_matched (example: esphome.impronte3q). The corresponding ESPHome actions must be named <node>_enroll, <node>_cancel_enroll and <node>_delete.

error.invalid_prefix: Use esphome.<node_name> with lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.

actions.title: Access profiles and actions
actions.description: Start in test mode. Each profile accepts any Home Assistant action sequence; no actions are executed while test mode is active. Available variables: finger_id, person_name, profile.

enroll.title: Enroll fingerprint
enroll.description: The slot must be physically empty. Access is granted only after the reader confirms enrollment and the database is saved.

data.name: Person's name
data.confirm_free_slot: I have verified this physical slot is empty

remove.title: Delete fingerprint
remove.description: The authorization is revoked on disk BEFORE the deletion command is sent to the reader. This cannot be undone automatically.

data.confirm_remove: Confirm permanent revocation and fingerprint deletion

error.operation_failed: The operation failed. Check Home Assistant logs and ESPHome availability.

abort.enrollment_started: Enrollment started. Follow the reader LEDs and check the registered fingerprints sensor.
abort.cancel_failed: Cancellation could not reach the reader.
abort.person_removed: Authorization revoked and physical deletion requested.
abort.deletion_check_hardware: Access was revoked; physical deletion may have failed. Check the reader.
abort.no_people: No registered people are in the database.
